text_en: Ah! City of bloodshed, utterly deceitful, full of booty— no end to the plunder!
text_cn: 祸哉！血债的城，满城欺诈，处处劫掠，抢夺不息。

text_en: The crack of whip and rumble of wheel, galloping horse and bounding chariot!
text_cn: 听，皮鞭飕飕，车轮隆隆，战马奔驰，战车疾驶，

text_en: Horsemen charging, flashing sword and glittering spear, piles of dead, heaps of corpses, dead bodies without end— they stumble over the bodies!
text_cn: 骑士跃马，刀剑晃亮，枪矛闪耀，被杀者众，死者成堆，尸体无边，人人为尸体绊倒：

text_en: Because of the countless debaucheries of the prostitute, gracefully alluring, mistress of sorcery, who enslaves nations through her debaucheries, and peoples through her sorcery,
text_cn: 这都是因那娇艳妖冶的淫妇，行妖术的女巫的许多淫行所致。她以淫荡欺骗了列邦，用妖术迷惑了万民。

text_en: I am against you, says the Lord of hosts, and will lift up your skirts over your face; and I will let nations look on your nakedness and kingdoms on your shame.
text_cn: 看，我必攻击你──万军上主的断语──我必将你的衣裙掀到你脸上，使万民见到你的裸体，使列邦看见你的耻辱；

text_en: I will throw filth at you and treat you with contempt, and make you a spectacle.
text_cn: 我要将粪溺抛在你身上侮辱你，使你成为鉴戒。

text_en: Then all who see you will shrink from you and say, “Nineveh is devastated; who will bemoan her? ” Where shall I seek comforters for you?
text_cn: 凡看见你的，必逃避你说：“尼尼微终于毁灭了！”谁会向她表同情？我从那里能找到安慰她的人？

text_en: Are you better than Thebes that sat by the Nile, with water around her, her rampart a sea, water her wall?
text_cn: 你哪里能胜过那位于尼罗河上，四面环水的诺阿孟？她有海为屏障，有水为垣墙；

text_en: Ethiopia was her strength, Egypt too, and that without limit; Put and the Libyans were her helpers.
text_cn: 雇士和埃及是她的力量，力大无穷；普特和利比亚是她的助手；

text_en: Yet she became an exile, she went into captivity; even her infants were dashed in pieces at the head of every street; lots were cast for her nobles, all her dignitaries were bound in fetters.
text_cn: 但是她也被掳去，充当俘虏，她的婴儿也在各街头被摔死，人抽签分配她的贵族，用铁链缚住她的缙绅。

text_en: You also will be drunken, you will go into hiding; you will seek a refuge from the enemy.
text_cn: 你也要这样被攻破而消失，你也要找一个安全处为逃避仇敌。

text_en: All your fortresses are like fig trees with first-ripe figs— if shaken they fall into the mouth of the eater.
text_cn: 你的一切堡垒好像早熟的无花果树，人一动摇，就落在食者的口里。

text_en: Look at your troops: they are women in your midst. The gates of your land are wide open to your foes; fire has devoured the bars of your gates.
text_cn: 看哪！在你中间的百姓都是妇女，你境内的门已为你的敌人敞开，火已烧毁了你的门闩。

text_en: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your forts; trample the clay, tread the mortar, take hold of the brick mold!
text_cn: 你应吸水防备围困，应巩固你的堡垒，踏黏土，踩胶泥，紧握砖型。

text_en: There the fire will devour you, the sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the locust. Multiply yourselves like the locust, multiply like the grasshopper!
text_cn: 火要在那里烧灭你，刀剑要歼灭你，【把你吞食有如蚱蜢】。你尽可增多你的人数有如蚱蜢，多如飞蝗；

text_en: You increased your merchants more than the stars of the heavens. The locust sheds its skin and flies away.
text_cn: 增加你的商贾，多过天上的星辰！──蚱蜢一脱壳就飞去了。

text_en: Your guards are like grasshoppers, your scribes like swarms of locusts settling on the fences on a cold day— when the sun rises, they fly away; no one knows where they have gone.
text_cn: 你的守卫正如蝗虫，你的官吏正像一群蚱蜢；冷天蛰伏在墙上，但太阳一升起，就飞去了，没有人知道它们究在何处。

text_en: Your shepherds are asleep, O king of Assyria; your nobles slumber. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
text_cn: 亚述王！你的牧者已酣睡，你的贵族已永眠，你的人民已散在各山上，无人再能聚集。

text_en: There is no assuaging your hurt, your wound is mortal. All who hear the news about you clap their hands over you. For who has ever escaped your endless cruelty?
text_cn: 你的创痍（yí）无法治疗，你的创伤是致命伤。凡听到你这消息的，都朝你鼓掌，因为有谁没有时常受过你的虐待？
